team_history.note: Traded from Pittsburgh to Dallas on 2025-05-07 for a 2026 third-round pick and a 2027 pick swap.

workload.note: Career year in first season with Dallas. Season concluded with a game vs. NYG on 2026-01-04.

contract.note: Playing 2026 on the franchise tag worth $27.298M fully guaranteed. Deadline for a long-term extension passed without a deal (per ESPN, 2026-08-04); Cowboys reportedly prioritizing extensions for CeeDee Lamb and Quinnen Williams instead. Signals 2026 is likely Pickens' last season in Dallas, with trade or free agency likely next offseason given rising WR market (e.g., Zay Flowers $140M, Drake London ~$141M deals cited as comparables).
